title: TikTok Shop MCP Server Terms
label: TIKTOK SHOP · TERMS AND POLICIES
subtitle: Updated 2026-09-28
html:
1. Partner and Developer Terms

These terms supplement and do not replace the TikTok Shop Partner Center Terms of Service and the TikTok Shop Developer Terms of Service that already bind you as a partner or developer. Where these terms and those agreements conflict as to model context protocol ("MCP") access, these terms control for the MCP feature only. All data-protection and compliance obligations in those agreements continue to apply.

2. Third-Party Services and Connecting Agents

The MCP server lets you connect third-party AI agents and tools of your choice to authorized TikTok Shop interfaces. TikTok does not select, vet, endorse, or control the AI agents, models, model providers, or other tools (collectively, "AI Tools") you connect. You are solely responsible for your choice of AI Tools, including the security, reliability, and legal compliance of such AI Tools, and you must ensure that your use of AI Tools is, in each case, approved pursuant to your agreement with, and any other authorizations by, the applicable seller. Your use of any AI Tools is governed by your agreement with those third parties that provide such AI Tools and TikTok is not a party to such agreements.

3. Authorized Access and Actions

You must ensure that AI Tools' access is scoped to the accounts, shops, and actions covered by your existing authorization from the relevant seller or shop. You may access only the interfaces enabled for MCP and only for the shops for which you hold a valid, current authorization. You must not use MCP to reach any account, shop, data, or action outside that authorization.

4. Permitted Purpose and Use Restrictions

You may use data accessed through MCP only to operate and provide your servicing tools to the specific seller that authorized the access. You must not:

  • aggregate, combine, or benchmark data across sellers, or use one seller's data to inform services, decisions or products for another seller;
  • use any data to build, train, or improve any AI Tools or any competing product, model, or dataset, or resell or redistribute insights derived from it;
  • disclose or otherwise make available data accessed through MCP, or any insights derived from such data, to any third party beyond what is strictly necessary to provide your servicing tools as authorized by the applicable seller;
  • derive, reconstruct, or infer non-public platform or marketplace-level data, including cross-seller competitive intelligence, from the data you access.

5. Seller Authorization and Responsibility

Before connecting any AI Tools to a seller's shop through MCP, you represent and warrant that you have obtained that seller's affirmative and informed permission to do so, and that you have disclosed to the seller what data and actions the connected AI Tools can access. You are solely responsible for the permissions you grant to any AI Tools and for the acts and omissions of any AI Tools you connect. You will indemnify TikTok for claims arising out of or relating to your use, configuration, operation, or deployment of AI Tools, including any AI Tools connection made without the authorizing seller's permission or outside the scope of that permission.

6. Your Responsibility for Agent Behavior

You are responsible for all activity conducted through MCP under your authorization, whether performed by you or by any AI Tools you have connected. This includes ensuring the AI Tools operate within the authorized scope, handle data lawfully, and do not perform any action these terms or your other agreements prohibit.

7. Data Handling and Transfer

You are responsible for the lawful handling of all data accessed through MCP, including any storage, cross-border transfer, or other processing by you or by any AI Tools you connect. You must not route data accessed through MCP to any AI Tools where doing so would breach applicable data-transfer or other data protection rules. On TikTok's request, you will disclose the identity of the AI Tools (e.g., the name of the agent or underlying model provider) you have connected. You must connect AI Tools only through an enterprise, business, or equivalent configuration under which the AI Tool provider is contractually prohibited from using data accessed through MCP to train, fine-tune, or improve its models, or from retaining that data for its own purposes. You must not connect any AI Tool through a consumer or free-tier service whose terms permit the provider to train on or retain input data. On TikTok's request, you will confirm the tier or configuration in use.

8. Read-Only Scope

MCP access under these pilot terms is read-only. You must not use MCP to write, modify, create, or delete any data or to take any action that changes the state of a shop, listing, order, or account. Any future write-enabled capability will be governed by separate or amended terms and a separate authorization.

9. Prohibited Activities

You must not attempt to circumvent rate limits, access controls, authorization scoping, or audit logging, reverse engineer the MCP interfaces, or use MCP in any way that disrupts or degrades the platform or other partners. You must not use MCP for any unlawful purpose or in violation of your other agreements with TikTok.

10. Logging, Deletion, and Audit

TikTok maintains logs of MCP activity, including the TSP account accessing through MCP, the time authorization takes effect, and the access behaviors and operations performed. You must maintain reasonable records of your MCP use and, on TikTok's request, delete data accessed through MCP and certify deletion. TikTok may audit your compliance with these terms and you will cooperate with any such audit.

11. Suspension and Revocation

TikTok may suspend or revoke your MCP access at any time, including for a specific TSP account, where TikTok reasonably believes these terms or your other agreements have been breached or where continued access presents a security, legal, or platform-integrity risk. Revocation of MCP access does not affect data you have already exported, and your obligations as to that data survive.

12. Data Protection Roles

You act as the authorizing seller's processor or as an independent controller whose actions are authorized by the applicable seller, as the case may be. You are not TikTok's processor and no data processing agreement between you and TikTok is created by virtue of your connection of any AI Tools via MCP. Your data-protection obligations to the seller and to data subjects are governed by your agreement with the seller and by applicable law.

13. No Responsibility for Third-Party Platforms and Agents

TikTok is not responsible for the availability, accuracy, security, or output of any AI Tools you connect through MCP, or for any decision you or the seller make in reliance on that output. You bear the risk of relying on any connected agent.

14. Region-Specific Terms

Additional or superseding terms may apply in specific markets. Where local terms conflict with these terms, the local terms control for that market.
